## Checklist

- [ ] The id is a domain I own, or `io.github.<my user>.<name>`.
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh extensions/<id>` passes locally.
- [ ] The version in `extension.json` moved, and the CHANGELOG says what changed.
- [ ] No prebuilt module, vendored binary or blob; dependencies by name with the lockfile.
- [ ] Licensed under MIT (this repository's) or an OSI license in the extension's folder.
